item.title: Gonzaga Basketball Doc ‘The Slipper Still Fits’ Sets March Release (Exclusive)
item.description: NBA standouts Steve Kerr, John Stockton and Chet Holmgren are among those featured in the Tubi Original film that focuses on head coach Mark Few's impressive run at the college hoops powerhouse.

item.title: Harvey Weinstein Replaces Legal Team as New York Retrial Looms
item.description: The imprisoned former producer has hired Jacob Kaplan of Agnifilo Intrater as he prepares for a retrial after New York’s highest court overturned his 2020 rape conviction.

item.title: NAACP Image Awards: ‘Sinners’ Captures Three Prizes on Third Night of Non-Televised Winners
item.description: 'Gracie's Corner,' 'Ironheart,' 'Celebrity Family Feud' and 'Straw' also scored multiple wins during the Wednesday virtual ceremony on YouTube.

item.title: Kristen Wiig Says ‘Bridesmaids’ Food Poisoning Scene Was Not in Original Script
item.description: Wiig starred alongside Rose Byrne, Maya Rudolph, Melissa McCarthy, Ellie Kemper and Wendi McLendon-Covey in the 2011 buddy comedy.

item.title: ‘Scream 7’ Director Kevin Williamson Reacts to Pro-Palestine Protesters Marching Outside L.A. Premiere
item.description: The demonstration was also in response to Melissa Barrera's firing from the film in November 2023 after she expressed support for Palestine.

item.title: Park Chan-wook Is the 2026 Cannes Jury President
item.description: The acclaimed South Korean director of 'Oldboy,' 'The Handmaiden' and 'No Other Choice' will head up the international jury that picks this year's Palme d'Or.

item.title: Harry Styles Says He Laughed at His Grandmother’s Funeral “Thinking About Inappropriate Cremation Songs”
item.description: The Grammy winner stopped by Brittany Broski’s 'Royal Court' to promote his upcoming album, 'Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally.'

item.title: Visual Effects Society Awards: ‘Avatar: Fire and Ash’ Leads With 7 Wins
item.description: 'KPop Demon Hunters' tops the animation categories.
